narrative: On 2026-10-19 Demo Rocket Battery ran a HIMARS live-fire qualification at Demo Range North. Launcher 1 fired 6 rockets: Avery Kestrel was launcher chief, Jordan Pike was gunner and Riley Marsh drove. Launcher 2 also fired, but its rocket count was not recorded. Casey Thorne was chief, Morgan Vale was on the gun and Taylor Brook drove.
